quarterly_data.signal: SolarEdge's 10-Q revenue by product line for the quarter ended June 30, 2026: batteries $126.0M (+86.3% YoY vs $67.6M), power optimizers $116.5M (-3.9% vs $121.3M), inverters $71.5M (-11.4% vs $80.6M), battery accessories $13.3M (+54.2% vs $8.6M), energy storage systems $0.0M (vs $8.1M). quarterly_data.signal: SolarEdge's 10-Q commitments as of June 30, 2026: purchase obligations of $340.0 million related to raw materials and commitments for the future manufacturing of its products, and open capital expenditure commitments of approximately $12.8 million, mainly automated assembly lines and other machinery, primarily for its new manufacturing sites in the U.S. The substantial majority of products is now manufactured in the United States, while certain components and subcomponents continue to be sourced from suppliers outside the United States, including from China.
